title: NASA announcement of possible life on Mars

tellings.quote: the the NASA just recently announced that they found some sort of life on Mars.

plain: NASA recently announced that it had found some sort of life on Mars, according to Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US agency for intercepting communications, hired him to speak with aliens. Sherman mentions the announcement in passing as something NASA said. If true, it would be the first official word of life beyond Earth.
